en.name: Writing workbench
en.description: Plan arguments, inspect provisional coverage, and request reviewable rewrites.
en.saveFirst: Open or save a Markdown paper in the open project folder first.
en.openFolder: Open a project folder to create and manage papers. Write in the native editor.
en.provisionalHelp: AI findings are provisional. Confirmation records your judgment, not a truth certificate. Changing the passage makes earlier confirmations stale.
en.stale: Older analysis — text or plan changed
en.noFindings: The model could not identify supported findings.
en.templateHelp: Export includes the plan structure, block purposes and component references. It excludes paper bodies, analysis, decisions and preferences. Copy JSON to save it elsewhere. Preview before importing as new into a saved blank paper; existing plans are never overwritten.
en.changed: The document or plan changed. Refresh and request a new proposal.
en.unresolved: Argument mapping unresolved. Restore distinct argument markers; history has not been reassigned.
en.unchanged: This text and plan have already been analyzed.
en.writeFirst: Write in this argument block first.
en.invalidReply: The provider returned an invalid response.
en.blankFirst: Open a saved blank paper to instantiate this template as new.
en.cost: Manual analysis only. Uses your Textus AI provider and may incur charges. Maximum six requests per minute; token cost is unavailable.
en.estimateHelp: Approximate cost using the prices you enter. Actual billing depends on the provider; this estimate is not a spending cap. Importing and switching views are local. Only Run requests assessment.
en.builderHelp: Upload or paste source text, select and edit candidate items, then build portable JSON. Extraction is local and does not decide which requirements to adopt. Paper templates contain a plan; rubric templates contain assessment rules.
